description: This file defines a CMake function called GetExternalCode, which facilitates fetching external code repositories (specifically supported for Git) at configure time. It handles cloning repositories, checking out specific versions, and removing existing directories if forced, by integrating Git commands during the CMake configuration process.

methods.name: GetExternalCode
methods.description: A CMake function that clones a Git repository at configure time, with options for specifying repository URL, version, destination directory, and force removal of existing source directory.
